description: Defines the AccountType enumeration representing different account types within the Fineract project, including methods for conversion and property checks.

classes.name: AccountType
classes.description: Enumeration for various types of accounts including utility methods for conversion and property checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Returns the AccountType corresponding to the provided integer value.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Returns the AccountType matching the provided name string.

methods.name: toEnumOptionData
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing all account types, useful for UI or API representations.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the account type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the account type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the account type in lowercase.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the account type is invalid.

methods.name: isIndividualAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is individual.

methods.name: isGroupAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is a group.

methods.name: isJLGAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is JLG.

methods.name: isGLIMAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is GLIM.

methods.name: isGSIMAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is GSIM.
